documentType.name: new starter form
documentType.preamble: This is a completed new starter or onboarding form. It may be handwritten and scanned. Only extract what the person has written; ignore printed instructions and example values on the form.

fields.name: legalName
fields.promptFragment: The person's full legal name as written. Do not correct spelling.

fields.name: preferredName
fields.promptFragment: The preferred or known-as name, if one is given.

fields.name: startDate
fields.promptFragment: The employment start date in ISO format.

fields.name: employmentType
fields.promptFragment: The employment type that is ticked or written.

fields.name: requiresDeviceAccess
fields.promptFragment: True if the form requests a laptop, phone or system access.

fields.name: emergencyContactProvided
fields.promptFragment: True if an emergency contact name and number are both filled in. Do not extract the contact's details.
